guide_start_one: Select Start with Pomo to open the scene and tools.
guide_start_two: Pomodoro is at the top left, scenes and settings at the top right, and music and dialogue at the bottom left.
guide_scene_one: Choose day or night yourself, or use Auto to follow the current time.
guide_scene_two: Change between reading, writing, and laptop typing, and adjust where Pomo looks.
guide_scene_three: Choose depth or sideways motion, then control it by dragging or with a supported device's gyroscope.
guide_pomodoro_cycle: A default cycle alternates {focus} minutes of focus with {shortBreak}-minute short breaks, followed by a {longBreak}-minute long break after {sessions} focus sessions.
guide_pomodoro_two: Select Pomo's face to start or pause immediately, and select the time display to open all controls.
guide_pomodoro_three: You can move to the next phase, end the current session, reset focus sessions, enable auto-start, and change durations.
guide_music_one: Play or pause, choose the previous or next track, seek, and adjust volume.
guide_music_two: The expanded player includes repeat all, repeat one, shuffle, and the playlist.
guide_dialogue_one: Create, listen to, edit, or delete dialogue in the Dialogue tab, and choose its voice model and voice.
guide_dialogue_two: In Events, connect dialogue to entering Pomofi and starting or ending focus and breaks.
guide_feed_one: Add an RSS or Atom URL or a recommended feed in the Feeds tab, then choose a voice.
guide_feed_two: The screen shows progress while new posts become dialogue and flags anything that needs attention.
guide_display_one: On supported devices, keep the screen from turning off while you focus.
guide_display_two: Set a screen saver delay to black out the display after inactivity, then return with touch, click, or a key press.
guide_display_three: Manage the scene, motion, wake lock, and screen saver from General.
